title: Slayer scene and edit, v2
description: The scene format slayer is growing into: every key of v1, held to the reader by its parity test, and the keys the reader does not take yet. v2 adds a date, one anchor for a scene, the globe beyond a terrain patch, scenes set in space, things in orbit or placed relative to one another, an attitude, an instrument eye, a sky of catalogued stars, a star as a body with its corona, the lantern, culture orbitals and a nebula as kinds, camera moves relative to things, and an edit of shots cut to a song's timeline. No reader takes v2 yet: it is the specification the reader grows into, one key at a time, each moving into v1 when the reader takes it.

setting.description: v2. ground: a scene on terrain, as every v1 scene is. space: no ground, location or weather; the sun is placed by the frame.

date.description: v2, keyhole gap 11. The day, so the sun and moon are placed by an ephemeris; authored sun and moon directions still win.

place.description: v2. Placed at the scene's anchor, its space frame, or, for a scene in space about one body, the origin; not by east and north.

around.description: v2. Placed round another thing of the set, by its name: an orbital round the lantern, a nebula round it all.

star.description: v2. For kind star: which star, its radius and surface read from celestial by name.

limb.description: v2. For kind star: how the disc darkens toward its edge.

panels.description: v2. For kind lantern: the swarm's arrangement; baseline is package lantern's, panels near six stellar radii in bands 0.4 radii wide.

turning.description: v2. For kind lantern: whether the swarm's rings turn.

lean.description: v2. For kind culture-orbital: its lean from the axis of what it goes round.

sense.description: v2. For kind culture-orbital: which way it turns, one way or the other.

lights.description: v2. For kind culture-orbital: the lights along its walls, black bodies across a range of temperatures.

thickness.description: v2. For kind nebula: its density, in cmd/orbital's units.

neon.description: v2. For kind nebula: the share of it that is neon.

argon.description: v2. For kind nebula: the share of it that is argon.

glow.description: v2. For kind nebula: how bright its glow is.

fps.description: v2. Frames a second, for a camera that moves.

eye.description: human, as in v1; or, v2 and keyhole gap 7, the instrument of a thing of the set, by its name, so the picture is what that instrument sees.

moves.description: v2. A camera that moves: each move from one place to another over a duration, looking at something as it goes.

duration.description: v2. How long a held camera holds; song means the span the edit gives it.

extent.description: terrain: the layer ends at the terrain patch's edge, as in v1. world, v2 and keyhole gap 10: it reaches the horizon, drawn coarser with distance.

space-length.description: v2. A length in metres, kilometres, or the radii of the star the scene is about.

sky-direction.description: v2. A direction on the sky, in degrees: right ascension and declination.

anchor.description: v2, keyhole gaps 5 and 6. One place, fixed for the whole scene, that the map, the maths and the terrain agree on; east, north and up are measured from it, from the ground to orbit.

value.description: metres, or lidar to read it from the terrain at the anchor.

globe.description: v2, keyhole gap 10. The world, not a patch: elevation near the anchor and a coarser model beyond it, the detail spent by each thing's size on the picture.

space-frame.description: v2. Where a scene set in space is, and when.

sky.description: v2. The sky behind everything, drawn from a catalogue, not painted.

orbit.description: v2, keyhole gaps 8 and 9. A thing in orbit, placed so it passes over another thing at the scene's time.

attitude.description: v2, keyhole gap 9. Which way a thing points: straight down, at a place on the sky, or at another thing; and which side faces the sun.

instrument-eye.description: v2, keyhole gap 7. What an instrument models: a pupil and a focal length, and so a diffraction limit. It does not trace the mirrors.

corona.description: v2. A star's corona as authored emission off its limb, shaped like the photographs; not simulated.

reach.description: how far it reaches, in the star's radii.

relative-place.description: v2, keyhole gap 4. A place set by a thing of the set: above it, behind it, at a distance, above its plane.

look.description: v2, keyhole gap 4. What a move looks at: a thing, or a place on the sky, with an offset to one side.

move.description: v2. One move of a camera: from one place to another, or held where it is while its field narrows, over a duration.

field.description: how wide the picture is across, at the thing looked at, from the move's start to its end.

edit.description: v2. Shots cut to a song. Shots are counted in the song's own bars and sections, never in seconds, so a tempo change moves every cut with it.

music.description: the song's file; never in a repository.

timeline.description: the song's timeline, as the beat tool writes it.

shot.description: v2. One shot of an edit: old footage, or a camera of a scene rendered for exactly its span.

fit.description: how a camera's moves meet the span: stretched to it, held at the end, or cut short.

song-point.description: v2. A point in the song: a bar of a section, a section's end, or the song's end.

timeline.description: v2. A song's timeline as the beat tool writes it, in seconds from the song's start: tempo, beats, bars, the big hits and the sections.
